cause: Path(name) on POSIX treats retained Windows backslashes as literal filename characters. relative_file joins the unnormalized evidence key to HERE, so the first retained evidence lookup fails even though the slash-normalized file exists with its expected digest.
scope: Original default verify-only CLI, run once in Ubuntu WSL. No wrapper edits or monkeypatches, no model enumeration, no Java process, no candidate workload. Independent normalized-path hashing is diagnostic only and does not convert the failed original verifier into a pass.
impact: The default retained-evidence verifier cannot complete on this POSIX environment. --execute uses the same verification preflight and is therefore also blocked before enumeration; that branch was not executed. This failure alone does not invalidate retained model results or establish failure on every POSIX installation.
